question: As of June 30, 2023, had Microsoft completed its acquisition of Activision Blizzard, and what was the status of each major regulatory review?

reference_facts.text: Microsoft announced a ~$68.7 billion all-cash deal to acquire Activision Blizzard
The US FTC filed an administrative complaint to block the deal
The UK CMA blocked the deal
The European Commission approved the deal subject to cloud-gaming remedies
The FTC sought a temporary restraining order and preliminary injunction in federal court; a TRO was granted

reference_status_at_cutoff: Not completed: blocked in the UK (under appeal), EU approved with remedies, US federal-court injunction proceedings pending.

question: As of November 30, 2023, what was the status of Adobe's proposed acquisition of Figma?

reference_facts.text: Adobe announced an agreement to acquire Figma for about $20 billion
The European Commission opened an in-depth (Phase II) investigation
The UK CMA published provisional findings raising competition concerns

reference_status_at_cutoff: Pending: under in-depth EU review and UK CMA Phase 2 with adverse provisional findings; not abandoned (abandonment came on 2023-12-18, after the cutoff).

question: As of the end of 2021, what was the status of Nvidia's proposed acquisition of Arm?

reference_facts.text: Nvidia agreed to buy Arm from SoftBank in a deal valued at about $40 billion
The European Commission opened an in-depth investigation
The US FTC sued to block the transaction

reference_status_at_cutoff: Pending and facing an FTC lawsuit plus EU and UK in-depth reviews; not terminated (termination was announced on 2022-02-08, after the cutoff).

question: As of October 31, 2023, had Broadcom closed its acquisition of VMware, and which approvals were still outstanding?

reference_facts.text: Broadcom announced an agreement to acquire VMware (about $61 billion)
The European Commission approved the deal with conditions
The UK CMA cleared the deal

reference_status_at_cutoff: Not closed; awaiting approval from China's market regulator (SAMR). The deal closed on 2023-11-22, after the cutoff.

question: As of June 30, 2024, what was the status of Kroger's proposed merger with Albertsons?

reference_facts.text: Kroger and Albertsons announced a merger agreement (about $24.6 billion)
The FTC and several states sued to block the merger
A federal court hearing on the FTC's preliminary injunction request was scheduled for August 2024

reference_status_at_cutoff: Pending litigation; merger not completed (it was later blocked in December 2024).

question: As of August 31, 2022, was Elon Musk's acquisition of Twitter going ahead?

reference_facts.text: Twitter agreed to be acquired by Elon Musk for about $44 billion ($54.20 per share)
Musk notified Twitter that he was terminating the agreement
Twitter sued Musk in the Delaware Court of Chancery to enforce the deal
The Delaware court scheduled a five-day trial starting October 17, 2022

reference_status_at_cutoff: Disputed: Musk sought to terminate, Twitter was suing to enforce; trial set for October 2022; deal not closed.

question: As of midday UTC on March 9, 2023, what was the financial situation of Silicon Valley Bank?

reference_facts.text: SVB Financial announced a planned ~$2.25 billion capital raise and a ~$1.8 billion loss on securities sales
SVB's shares fell sharply after the announcement

reference_status_at_cutoff: Still operating under stress after announcing a capital raise and securities loss; it had not failed (regulators closed it on 2023-03-10, after the cutoff).

question: As of November 7, 2022, what was the status of the crypto exchange FTX?

reference_facts.text: CoinDesk reported that much of Alameda Research's balance sheet consisted of FTT tokens
Binance's CEO said Binance would sell its FTT holdings

reference_status_at_cutoff: Operating under a liquidity scare with heavy withdrawals; no bankruptcy filing and no Binance rescue deal yet (both came after the cutoff).

question: As of July 20, 2024, was Joe Biden still running for re-election as the Democratic candidate?

reference_facts.text: Biden and Trump held their first general-election debate
The White House said Biden had tested positive for COVID-19

reference_status_at_cutoff: Yes, still the presumptive Democratic nominee despite pressure to withdraw (he withdrew on 2024-07-21, after the cutoff).

question: As of June 21, 2023, what was known about the missing Titan submersible?

reference_facts.text: OceanGate's Titan lost contact during a dive to the Titanic wreck
The US Coast Guard said searchers had detected underwater noises

reference_status_at_cutoff: Missing; search and rescue ongoing. Debris and the implosion finding were announced on 2023-06-22, after the cutoff.

question: As of January 10, 2024, what regulatory action followed the Alaska Airlines Flight 1282 door-plug blowout?

reference_facts.text: A door plug blew out of an Alaska Airlines Boeing 737 MAX 9 shortly after takeoff from Portland
The FAA ordered the temporary grounding of certain Boeing 737 MAX 9 aircraft (about 171 planes) for inspections

reference_status_at_cutoff: Affected 737 MAX 9 aircraft remained grounded pending FAA-approved inspection procedures; NTSB investigation ongoing.

provenance.origin: FAA Emergency Airworthiness Directive / FAA statement (2024-01-06)
provenance.notes: Widely republished; reports quoting the FAA statement count as one origin.

question: As of July 20, 2024, what caused the global IT outage of July 19, 2024 and how many devices were affected?

reference_facts.text: A faulty CrowdStrike Falcon sensor content update caused Windows hosts to crash
Microsoft estimated that about 8.5 million Windows devices were affected

reference_status_at_cutoff: Root cause identified as a CrowdStrike content update (not a cyberattack); fix deployed, recovery ongoing.

provenance.origin: CrowdStrike statement and Microsoft blog post
provenance.notes: The device estimate originates from Microsoft's blog; republications are not independent.

question: As of July 27, 2023, what was the Federal Reserve's target range for the federal funds rate?

reference_facts.text: The FOMC raised the target range by 25 basis points to 5.25%-5.50%

question: As of the end of November 20, 2023 (UTC), who was the CEO of OpenAI and what had happened to Sam Altman?

reference_facts.text: OpenAI's board removed Sam Altman as CEO; Mira Murati was named interim CEO
Emmett Shear was named interim CEO of OpenAI
Microsoft said Altman and Greg Brockman would join Microsoft to lead a new advanced AI research team

reference_status_at_cutoff: Altman was not CEO; Emmett Shear was interim CEO; reports about a possible return conflicted. The reinstatement agreement came after the cutoff.

question: As of March 21, 2024, what was the publicly confirmed health situation of Catherine, Princess of Wales?

reference_facts.text: Kensington Palace said she had undergone planned abdominal surgery
Several agencies withdrew a Mother's Day photo over editing; she apologised the next day

reference_status_at_cutoff: Recovering from planned abdominal surgery; no further diagnosis publicly confirmed (the cancer announcement came on 2024-03-22, after the cutoff). Online speculation was not confirmed fact.

question: As of August 20, 2023, had China Evergrande filed for bankruptcy in the United States, and what kind of filing was it?

reference_facts.text: Evergrande filed a Chapter 15 petition in the US Bankruptcy Court in Manhattan seeking recognition of its offshore restructuring

reference_status_at_cutoff: It filed for Chapter 15 recognition of foreign restructuring proceedings, not a liquidation; headlines describing it as 'filing for bankruptcy' overstated the stage.
